rules: Data origin is independent of hosting location.
Technical wells, objects, timepoints and biological replicates are different units.
QC observations are not causal diagnoses; public reference studies are not screening treatments.
No automatic relationship is inferred from filenames, colors or similar specimen names.
Never include private ReviewDecision rows in a shared ontology or agent without a separate reviewed entitlement design.
A source relationship does not grant permission to access that source.
